test_objective: Check that you can create a batch of entities where some will succeed and others will fail

test_cases.name: 003_02_01 Create a batch of two valid entities and one invalid entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a batch of two valid entities and one invalid entity
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Batch Create Entities with Response Status Code set to 207     and
        Batch Create Entities with Response body containing batch operation result set to '${expected_batch_operation_result}'     and
        Query Entities with Check Created Resource Set To and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to '${None}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/create'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to '' and
 payload set to a list of entities to be created
}
